title: Chapter 48 The Life Story Of Lu Xue'S Mother
content:
Chapter 48 The Life Story Of Lu Xue'S Mother

This sword is so terrifying.

However, what is even more terrifying is that such a magic sword actually recognized this human woman as the main person.

For a moment, all the creatures present looked at Lu Xue with deep fear and solemnity.

And the old man was already so shocked that he couldn't stop his mouth.

This woman from the same tribe who happened to meet by chance was so difficult.

I am really clumsy this time.

Seeing them like this, Lu Xue snorted coldly.

Let’s see who dares to bully himself so blatantly.

And at this moment, a terrifying aura suddenly came.

Everyone was shocked and looked up.

I saw a huge thing covering the sky and the sun covering everyone's heads.

That was a giant eagle!

His terrifying aura made all the creatures present tremble.

"It's over, the Lord of Sky Eagle City is here."

"It's normal to attract the city lord to such a big disturbance."

The creatures around him whispered.

The next moment, the giant eagle turned into a middle-aged man and appeared in the field.

Immediately, the lord of Tianying City looked directly at Lu Xue.

"You killed?"

Lu Xue shook her head.

Seeing this, the city lord frowned.

"Didn't you kill?"

Lu Xue pointed to the sword beside her and said, "It killed it."

Xuanyuan Sword:...

Upon hearing this, the city lord was speechless for a moment.

"Do you know, killing is not allowed in the city."

Lu Xue still shook her head.

She just came, but she didn't know the rules, and it was obvious that the other party was provoking her first.

At this time, a beautiful woman suddenly appeared next to the city lord.

He glanced at Lu Xue indifferently and was about to speak, but suddenly he was stunned.

When Lu Xue saw the beautiful woman, she was stunned.

The blood in the body suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, a phoenix sounded throughout the world.

The huge ice phoenix vision appeared from Lu Xue's body, and the surrounding temperature dropped rapidly in an instant, making the cold air rush.

"Bingfeng Bloodline! She is a descendant of the Bingfeng Clan!!"

The Lord of Tianying City said in shock, then suddenly turned his head and looked at the beautiful woman.

On the side, the beautiful woman also looked in disbelief.

Because, she is from the Bingfeng clan.

Feeling the restless blood in his body, Lu Xue quickly suppressed it.

Fortunately, I have the Extreme Ice Spirit Body, otherwise it would be really difficult to suppress.

Seeing Lu Xue easily suppressing Bingfeng's bloodline, the beautiful woman was shocked again.

Immediately, he appeared directly beside Lu Xue and was about to speak.

A long sword suddenly blocked her.

As long as she dares to take another step forward, Xuanyuan Sword will let her body separate without hesitation.

"you,,"

The beautiful woman looked at Lu Xue in front of her and was a little hesitant.

Seeing this, the city lord on the side immediately understood.

"Everything comes back!"

With an angry shout, all the creatures present scattered.

Only the old man was still sitting there.

Looking at the old man, the city lord frowned slightly.

"Are you deaf when I speak?"

The old man hesitated and said, "City, Lord, I will live here."

......

An embarrassing aura suddenly appeared in the field.

The beautiful woman looked at Lu Xue and said softly, "Can you talk?"

Lu Xue felt the familiar aura in the other person's body, hesitated for a while, and finally nodded.

Immediately, the three of them headed towards the city lord's mansion.

......

In the city lord's mansion.

"My name is Yan Luo, a member of the Bingfeng tribe."

The beautiful woman introduced herself.

On the side, the Lord of Tianying City also spoke, "My name is Yingchi, the Lord of Tianying City."

Seeing this, Lu Xue also said, "My name is Lu Xue, I am from Huangcheng."

"Wild City?"

Both of them were confused.

And Lu Xue is no longer surprised by this reaction.

In this world of all spirits, no one recognizes the deserted city.

Because the deserted city is in the Hongmeng universe.

Seeing that Lu Xue didn't explain, the two of them didn't say anything.

"Lu Xue, who are your parents?"

At this time, Yan Luo asked anxiously.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue hesitated and said, "My father is the lord of the Huangcheng City."

"What about your mother?"

"I, I haven't seen my mother before."

As long as she can remember, there was only Lu Daosheng by her side.

Since childhood, the father and daughter have been dependent on each other.

Hearing this, Yan Luo frowned slightly.

Then, Yan Luo took a deep breath and finally asked, "Do you know, is your mother a human?"

"ah?"

Lu Xue was stunned.

Why did she feel that the other person is scolding her?

But she has no evidence.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue said, "Yes, it should be."

My father never said that my mother is not a human being.

Hearing this, Yan Luo took a few steps back, his face full of shock.

"Miss Yan, what's wrong with you?"

Yingchi worried.

At this time, Yan Luo's eyes were already red.

"Lu Xue, can you give me a drop of your blood?"

Yan Luo looked at Lu Xuedao with a begging gaze.

This scene made Lu Xue a little confused. What's wrong?

Obviously, her not-so-smart little brain didn't understand what was going on.

But she gave it.

Yan Luo received the drop of bright red blood and immediately took a drop of her own blood.

After some operation, two drops of blood suddenly resonated.

At this moment, Yan Luo cried directly.

On the side, Yingchi keenly captured the nature of this matter.

Masaka!

Could it be!

Yingchi looked at Lu Xue and Yan Luo again.

It seems that it is really possible.

Lu Xue was stunned at this moment, and then finally reacted. Suddenly, Lu Xue also looked at Yan Luo with red eyes.

The next moment, Lu Xue went forward and hugged Yan Luo.

"Mom, after so many years, why did you leave me and dad behind?"

Lu Xue cried so hard that she simply buried her face directly into the proud holy peak.

At this moment, Yan Luo was stunned.

"Uh, that, Xiaoxue, I'm not your mother."

Ga~

The scene suddenly became extremely awkward again.

Lu Xue:! ! !

Hearing this, Lu Xue quickly let go of Yan Luo.

"Well, that's it, I'm joking."

Lu Xue showed an awkward and polite smile, and then hurriedly stepped aside.

But at this time, Yan Luo said again: "I am indeed not your mother, but I am indeed your relative."

Yan Luo took a deep breath and then slowly said, "I am your aunt, your mother's sister."

"Ah?"

......

After a long time.

Yan Luo briefly described Lu Xue about her mother.

Lu Xue's biological mother, named Yan Lingyun, is a human race, and she also has the blood of the ice phoenix.

Back then, because Lu Xue's mother was a human race, although she had the blood of the Ice Phoenix, she was also discriminated against by the Ice Phoenix clan. Yan Lingyun's mother's identity was low and she was just a maid. In the end, Yan Lingyun's father, that is, Lu Xue, was the father of Yan Lingyun, who was also a maid. Under pressure from the clan, his grandfather exiled Yan Lingyun to a low-level small world.

Hearing this, Lu Xue remained silent for a long time.

My mother's experience was so miserable.

Then where is she now, why did she leave herself and her father?

Lu Xue was puzzled, "Emm, aunt, do you know where my mother is now?"

Lu Xue asked.

Hearing this, Yan Luo didn't say anything.

In fact, this is also her problem.

I thought my sister was still in that small world, but now it seems that this is not the case.

But with the other party's cultivation level, it should be impossible to leave the small world by yourself.

Looking at Lu Xue's worried expression, Yan Luo sighed in her heart and then comforted her: "Your mother, she should be fine."

Lu Xue nodded.

She believed this, otherwise, with her father's temperament and ability, if something happened to her mother, she would probably have been killed directly.

How could you still be in a safe career in the Hongmeng Universe?
